needs.what: a one-shot op (or a `next_spell` option on a grant op) that gives the next spell its controller casts this turn a pay_generic_with currency -- here tap_creatures (convoke) -- consumed by that one cast and expiring at end of turn
needs.why_existing_wont_do: Convoke exists only as the card-level `pay_generic_with` and the permanent static `grant_pay_generic_with`, which lasts while the source is on the battlefield and covers every matching spell, not just the next one this turn. The `next_spell` one-shots (`grant_flash_permission`, `next_spell_cost_reduction`, `uncounterable_this_turn`) grant flash, a discount or uncounterability, never a pay_generic_with currency
